title: Three Summers and One Short Hut
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（人与自然·自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（人与自然·自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：fisherman　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fisherman 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the keeper ① thanked a fisherman that no trader on the shore would have named, and he said the thanking was the whole of the morning. The ② fisherman, meaning the man himself and not the boat, ran three summers and stayed unnamed in the book; a fisherman, he said, is the only thing on a shore that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ fisherman on that shore had the same short hut beside him, and the ④ fisherman at the far bend, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fisherman, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the keeper said the naming is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fisherman was the whole of the matter, meaning the angler and not the man. The ⑥ fisherman, meaning the angler and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; fisherman, he said, is either somebody you thank or the only word that means both a working man and an angler. He said the angler is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ fisherman had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short hut. The ⑧ fisherman of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in August, was one shore and three summers of naming; fisherman, he said, is either the one at the far bend or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fisherman I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest on the shore. A ⑩ fisherman, my mother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being named; every fisherman, she said, is an angler that has agreed to look like a working man. She said the angler was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 渔民；渔夫（指岸上每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 渔民（指那一位本身，与渔船相对）
C. 固定搭配：thank a fisherman 感谢一位渔民
D. n. 渔民（指留给孩子们的那一位）
E. n. 渔民（抽象总称，指一处岸上的致谢之事）
F. n. 渔民（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一位）
G. n. 垂钓者；钓鱼的人（指一件事里人人都等却无人说出名字的那样人）
H. n. 垂钓者（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说出名字的那样人）

items.q: thanked a fisherman that no trader on the shore would have named
The fisherman, meaning the man himself and not the boat
the fisherman at the far bend

answers.why: thank a fisherman 意为“感谢一位渔民”，1969 年那位守护人感谢了一位岸上没有一位商贩肯说出名字的渔民。
fisherman 意为“渔民”，指那一位本身而不是渔船，他经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
fisherman 意为“渔民”，指岸上每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一间矮矮的小屋。
fisherman 意为“渔民”，指留给孩子们的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fisherman 意为“垂钓者、钓鱼的人”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说出名字的那样人，叔叔说那位垂钓者就是那件事的全部。
fisherman 意为“垂钓者”，指人人都等却无人说出名字的那样人而不是那位渔民，是事情里人人都等、却无人说出名字的人。
fisherman 意为“渔民”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一位，到 1976 年这一位成了计划里的一行。
fisherman 意为“渔民”，守护人八月写道，整件事的致谢之事是一处岸滩和三个夏天的说出名字。
fisherman 意为“渔民”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一位，1978 年结束了，至今仍被说成岸上最安静的一位。
fisherman 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，一位渔民是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的人。
